title: Bhim Singh v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Vineet Saran, J.; Ran Vijai Singh, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; EE to decide representation under cl. 6.5
headnote: A consumer billed under LMV-1(a) and later charged under LMV-1(c) was relegated to Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ was disposed of with a direction that a fresh comprehensive representation to the Executive Engineer, PVVNL, Baghpat, be considered and decided in accordance with law, preferably within three weeks.
facts: The petitioner, a consumer of Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. at Baghpat, was billed under tariff LMV-1(a). The Corporation later applied tariff LMV-1(c). He represented to the Superintending Engineer and then filed this writ. Counsel for the Corporation stated that a dispute of this kind is to be decided by the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.holding: A dispute over change of tariff from LMV-1(a) to LMV-1(c) is to be decided by the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5. The writ was disposed of with a direction that if the consumer files a fresh comprehensive representation before the Executive Engineer, PVVNL, Power Supply Division, Baghpat, it shall be considered and decided in accordance with law, preferably within three weeks of filing.

not_decided.point: Whether the change of tariff from LMV-1(a) to LMV-1(c) was lawful
